bio.text: Eric Yonce is the Democratic nominee for Florida's 6th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was born in Hollywood, Florida, graduated from North Marion High School, and is a business owner.

According to his Ballotpedia survey, he grew up in the 6th District, worked more than 20 years in big-box retail, hiked the Appalachian Trail in 2022, and now works in real estate and remodels vintage Airstream trailers.
